	definition:

		existsSup: Boolean = if sups.isEmpty() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		Supplier.allInstance()->isUnique(o: Supplier|o.Id)
	postcondition:
		result = existsSup
}
